method: Power-balance torque constant from ODrive digital telemetry (no scope). At each no-load steady speed, electromagnetic torque T_em = (P_elec - 1.5*R_s*Iq^2) / omega_mech; Kt = slope of T_em vs Iq (through origin). psi_f = Kt / (1.5 * n_p); Ke_mech = n_p * psi_f. Scope back-EMF routes (disconnect coast-down, powered no-load terminal voltage) failed here on the FIXTURE, not signal size (this motor's back-EMF 1.41 V at 120 rps exceeds the steel rotor's 1.21 V): self-powered measurement leaves current in the phases, so disconnect captures are dominated by 60 Hz mains pickup + Vbus cap discharge and powered terminal voltage is contaminated by I*Z (~1.16 V at 120 rps, comparable to the back-EMF). The power-balance route uses reliable digital telemetry (Iq, P_elec); a clean open-phase back-EMF is recoverable on the steel rotor's external-drive jig (see README).

conditions.instrument: ODrive Micro (S1) FOC telemetry, Iq/Id/P_elec; R_s = 0.139 ohm (phase)
conditions.notes: No-load drag sweeps 10-80 rps, CW+CCW averaged. Two independent runs same day (morning 11:28, afternoon 15:59). Rotor-only (no gearbox). Captured in the upstream actuator bench project; generic naming here per OSS policy.

uncertainty.note: Run-to-run half-spread (0.304 vs 0.321 mWb). Soft UPPER bound: the through-origin method itself inflates Kt ~5% vs a physical fit (T_em = Kt*Iq + P_inv/omega, ~20 mW inverter loss, R^2 0.88->0.99), which gives psi_f ~0.299 mWb. CW/CCW differ +-5% (0.287/0.318).

model_comparison.basis: psi_f_model_mWb and over_prediction_pct are smooth-bore vs the recorded 0.312; the note uses Carter-consistent (0.438) vs the bias-corrected 0.299 (+47%).
model_comparison.note: Model over-predicts by +47% vs the bias-corrected estimate (~0.299 mWb); the recorded 0.312 is a through-origin upper bound (~5% inverter-loss inflation). Decomposition: ~2/3 is the same raw-2D bias the steel rotor shows (grade + 3D + profile); ~1/3 is an aluminum-specific gap OVER-credit -- the model predicts +29% flux from the tighter gap but the two rotors deliver only +12% (zhu_howe field ~2.5x too gap-sensitive). NOT gap amplification, NOT a magnet-grade signal.
